1.0.1.en: Added the network map: every device drawn as a star joined to the ones it relays through, the route each takes back to Homey, and a quality grade on every hop with the weakest links listed first.

1.1.0.en: Added fullscreen for the network map. On a phone held upright the map turns sideways, so turning the phone gives a wide view, and tapping a device shows its route to Homey in a panel beside the map.

1.2.0.en:
• Browser view: the full visualizer in its own browser tab, served by Homey on your local network. Switch it on at the bottom of the settings page; on a computer the Browser button then opens it. It has no login, so anyone on your network can open it while it is on.
• Snapshot history: the app can save your Zigbee network every 1, 2, 4 or 8 hours, keeping up to 24. Switch it on with the gear in the browser view, then step back through the snapshots.
• See what changed: devices that switched parent, joined or left are listed in a Changes tab and ringed on the map, and every device shows its route history, with a warning when it keeps switching parents.
• Download the whole history as one file, summarised for analysis by an AI. The network key is never included.
• Load a saved Zigbee dump in the browser view to look at it, and keep it on the Homey if you like.
• Devices that share a network address are both shown now, with a Conflicts counter, and stale routes are linked to the device that most likely left them behind.

1.3.0.en: Added a Zigbee map widget for your Homey dashboards. It draws the network map in the space you give it, square, wide or tall, with the number of links per quality grade along the bottom, and tapping a device shows its route to Homey. In the widget's settings you choose which devices are named, whether stale routes are shown, and how often it refreshes.

1.3.1.en: Helping add Z-Wave, Thread or Matter to the visualizer: the Load dialog in the browser view can now download a raw dump of every network on your Homey, to share on the forum. Network keys and other secrets are left out.
